reference_sql:
SELECT order_line_id, net_revenue_eur,
       CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 500 THEN 'high'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 'mid'
            ELSE 'low'
       END AS value_band
FROM sales
WHERE order_line_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
alternatives: SELECT order_line_id, net_revenue_eur, CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 500 THEN 'high' WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 100 THEN 'mid' WHEN net_revenue_eur < 100 THEN 'low' ELSE 'unknown' END AS value_band FROM sales WHERE order_line_id >= 1 AND order_line_id <= 20

SELECT order_line_id, net_revenue_eur, CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur < 100 THEN 'low' WHEN net_revenue_eur < 500 THEN 'mid' WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 500 THEN 'high' ELSE 'unknown' END AS value_band FROM sales WHERE order_line_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
